name: seed-assessment-drafter
description: Drafts a traceable one-page seed-stage company assessment from a deck, website, founder bios and call notes. Every claim cites its passage; nothing decides.

scripts.start: node assess.mjs && node eval.mjs && node scripts/check-tags.mjs && node report.mjs
scripts.deploy: node scripts/smoke.mjs && railway up --detach && echo 'Deployed. Check the live app with: node scripts/smoke.mjs --url https://northledge-assessor-production.up.railway.app'
